scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: EMPORIA
other_conditions: Eligible entities include Central/State Handloom and Handicrafts Development Corporations
Other eligible government corporations/agencies promoted by state or local governments
Eligible NGOs, registered Self Help Groups (SHGs), local statutory bodies, exporter bodies/associations
Apex Cooperative Societies and national level Apex Societies registered under the Society or Trust Act
Organizations such as IICT, MHSC, HMCM, NIFT, and Export Promotion Councils
Producer companies registered under Section 8 of the Companies Act working for promotion and development of handicrafts and handlooms
Implementation can also be carried out by the department
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹60 lakh for new emporia and ₹15 lakh for strengthening/renovation, with 80‑90% of costs funded by the Handicrafts Department and the remainder by the implementing agency.
